risks.description: Delay in receiving production API credentials from the third‑party payment vendor, blocking backend integration.
Chosen UI component library may not fully meet accessibility requirements, potentially requiring a mid‑project replacement.
Staging environment instability blocking QA regression testing for three consecutive days.
Potential release date slip of one to two weeks if vendor credential delay is not resolved within five business days.

delivery_forecast: The project is currently at‑risk. Frontend development remains on schedule, but backend integration is stalled due to a two‑week delay in payment vendor credentials, and staging instability has blocked QA for three days. These blockers threaten the end‑of‑month release, potentially pushing it back by one to two weeks. Escalation efforts are underway, but the critical path remains uncertain, so the project is not on track.
